platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.seoDescription: ReelFetch looks up Facebook videos through the official Graph API when a server access token is configured. Share links without a numeric video id are not resolved.

faqs.question: Can ReelFetch download Facebook videos right now?
faqs.answer: Only when the server has a Facebook user or Page access token that is allowed to read the video. The official Graph API source field is the file address. Without a token, lookup returns PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED and nothing is downloaded.

faqs.question: Which Facebook URL formats are recognized?
faqs.answer: Numeric watch, reel, and videos links can be sent to the Graph API. facebook.com/share and fb.watch short links do not contain a video id. ReelFetch does not open those pages to extract one.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.seoDescription: YouTube URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. No YouTube video lookup or download integration is currently connected.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch currently process YouTube links?
faqs.answer: No. This page is a non-functional status page. A URL may be recognized by format, but no YouTube service is connected.

faqs.question: Will every YouTube link be downloadable?
faqs.answer: No such availability is promised. Any future service would depend on an authorized source and the options it actually provides.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.seoDescription: TikTok URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. No TikTok video lookup or download integration is currently connected.

faqs.question: Can I download a TikTok video with ReelFetch?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch does not currently connect to a TikTok lookup or download service.

faqs.question: Does URL recognition confirm that a video is available?
faqs.answer: No. Recognition only identifies a URL format; it does not access or check the video.

platforms.name: X
platforms.seoDescription: X URL formats are listed in the ReelFetch platform registry. No X video lookup or download integration is currently connected.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch process links from X?
faqs.answer: No. The current page is a status template, and there is no X video lookup or download integration.

faqs.question: What does a recognized X URL mean?
faqs.answer: It means only that the hostname matches an X URL format. It does not mean the linked video has been checked.

platforms.name: Reddit

faqs.answer: No. This status page does not connect to Reddit or inspect linked videos.
